description: Producer-consumer relay tasks where one agent must move an object to a transfer receptacle and another agent must complete final delivery.

scene_scan.candidate_rule: Contains one pickupable object, one transfer receptacle, and one final target receptacle. Generated living-room instances are kept only when source-to-transfer and transfer-to-target placements both succeed.

goal_predicate_definitions.buffer_station(transfer): The transfer receptacle is the required handoff point between Source and Target.
goal_predicate_definitions.legal_plan: The object must pass through the transfer receptacle before final placement.
